title: Magyar titkok: Regény (3. kötet)
summary: "Magyar titkok: Regény (3. kötet)" by Ignácz Nagy is a romantic novel published between 1844-1845. The story follows Bende, a brave hero who pursues Sobri, a master of disguise and seducer of women through the streets of Pest. Yet this is more than a crime tale—it's a vivid portrait of 1840s Budapest life.
